title: Honestli — Digital Verification
description: A freelance Android app that fights misinformation by turning photos and videos into tamper-proof Digital Originals, backed by C2PA metadata and blockchain anchoring.
overview: Honestli is a freelance Android project built to fight misinformation. It turns photos and videos into tamper-proof Digital Originals that anyone can verify later.

Each Digital Original carries C2PA provenance metadata and is anchored on a blockchain, so its origin can be checked and any edit detected. Verified content can then be shared directly with newsrooms, without giving up the user's privacy.

features.title: Digital Originals
features.description: Create tamper-proof Digital Originals that can be verified at any time.

features.title: C2PA provenance
features.description: Content carries C2PA metadata describing where it came from and how it was made.

features.title: Blockchain anchoring
features.description: Originals are anchored on a blockchain, so any later change can be detected.

features.title: Share with newsrooms
features.description: Send verified photos and videos straight to newsrooms, securely and without giving up privacy.

title: Cariboo — Car Management
description: My own car-management app, live on Google Play: fuel, expenses, service reminders and statistics for every car you own.
overview: Cariboo is an offline-first Android app for everything that comes with owning a car: fuel, expenses, maintenance and paperwork, for one car or a whole household's.

I built it end to end, from the first screen to the Play Store release, with Jetpack Compose, Material 3 and Clean Architecture. Releases are automated too: a single GitHub Actions run bumps the version, builds a signed APK and publishes the release. It's available in English and Greek.

features.title: Fuel tracking
features.description: Log refills with cost, litres and odometer. Consumption (L/100km) and price per litre are calculated automatically, with optional GPS location.

features.title: Expenses & services
features.description: Track services, repairs, insurance, parking, tolls and your own categories, with full history and filters.

features.title: Service reminders
features.description: Date or mileage reminders that notify you a day before the due date or within 500 km of the target.

features.title: Statistics & charts
features.description: Interactive charts for cost, distance, consumption and refills, plus year-to-year and car-to-car comparisons.

features.title: Forecasts & insights
features.description: Forecasts fuel cost per km and efficiency with Holt's linear smoothing, and flags unusual expenses.

features.title: Voice entry
features.description: Add a refill just by saying it. Speech is turned into structured data with OpenAI GPT.

features.title: Multiple cars & documents
features.description: Keep insurance, inspection (KTEO) and tyre details for every car, and attach PDFs or photos to each one.

features.title: Widgets, backup & themes
features.description: Home-screen widgets for quick entry, JSON and Excel/CSV import/export, and 30+ colour palettes.
